subject.title: CI: gateway-protocol event coverage check for mobile clients

question: Should the linked follow-up PR land a blocking preflight mobile protocol coverage guard after the Swift extractor blocker is resolved?
rationale: The remaining work changes CI enforcement policy for native mobile diffs and the issue has the protected `maintainer` label, so automation should not choose the final guard scope without maintainer intent.

options.title: Fix then land the preflight guard
options.body: Repair the Swift constant false-positive path, keep the manifest-gated preflight coverage step, and close this issue when the focused PR merges.

options.title: Hold for CI ownership
options.body: Pause the linked PR if maintainers want protocol coverage to live in a different workflow or trigger policy.

options.title: Accept partial coverage temporarily
options.body: Leave the merged first-pass checker as-is while explicitly accepting that native-only and constant-backed iOS drift remain possible.

recommendation.title: Fix then land the preflight guard
recommendation.body: Repair the Swift constant false-positive path, keep the manifest-gated preflight coverage step, and close this issue when the focused PR merges.

likelyOwner.reason: steipete is assigned to this issue and owns both the first-pass checker and the active follow-up PR.
